text: Xy'rath's Signature Saber is looted from Xy'rath the Covetous at the Ageless Shards in Zereth Mortis.

Ya'rika is a draenei who acted as an escort to Ambassador Zekhan and pathfinder Rexxar on the Azuremyst Isles after the Fourth War. The draenei guided them through the Exodar and the areas of the isle, revealing information about the places they visited, problems that were present, as well about the naaru that helped them in the past and about the local satyrs.

__NOTOC__ Xy Never, Ever Marks the Spot. is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Artificer Xy'mox with all players under the effects of pilfered artifacts in the Sepulcher of the First Ones on Normal difficulty or higher.

__NOTOC__ Xy'varek is one of the broker assassins sent by Cartel Xy to kill Firim in Zereth Mortis, seen during Unseen Agents. They are located in the Great Veldt, interfering with one of Firim's Triggered Traps.
Xy Captain's Crossbow drops from Artificer in Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Yerili is a blue dragonspawn located at Algeth'era Court in Thaldraszus.
YZ-85 Biorearrangement Unit is a mechagnome located in the Spark of Imagination in Ulduar during Spark of Imagination (quest).
__NOTOC__ YZ-37 Biorearrangement Unit is a mechagnome located in the Temple of Storms in the Storm Peaks.
Yak Milk Pudding is sold by Hearthkeeper Erden in Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains for .
Yikko is a green drakonid found admiring Kazra in central Valdrakken.
Yennu's Kite can be found stuck in a tree at the Crumbling Cliffs in the Waking Shores. Looting the kite provides the toy and a Dragon Isles Supply Cache.
Yellowfang is a house cat located Teerakai in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
__NOTOC__ Yennu is a tuskarr child located on the Dragon Isles.
__NOTOC__ Yetor a yeti located in a cave in the Upper Frostlands in the Azure Span.
Yggdras Worms are jormungar located in the Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak. Three spawn when Yggdras is defeated.
__NOTOC__ Yamakh is a goat located in Azure Span during Grand Hunts.
__NOTOC__ Xy Relic Dealer is a broker located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
__NOTOC__ Yaankhi is a mammoth located in the Azure Span during Grand Hunts.
__NOTOC__ Yihan Thornpaw is a pandaren child located in Algeth'ar Tower in Thaldraszus.
Yellow Tweed Cap is available for purchase from the Trading Post during September for 450 Trader's Tender.
Yellow War Ottuk is a quest reward from Our Ferocious, Armored Steeds. It is also sold by Tatto and Murik in the Azure Span for .
Yennu's Toy Boat is looted from a Tuskarr Toy Boat in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Yennu's Map is found next to Yennu in the Flowing Forest in Thaldraszus. It shows the way to a Sand Pile at the Shifting Sands.
Yenajz's Chitinous Stompers drop from Warbringer Yenajz at the Precipice of Oblivion in Stormsong Valley.
Yarren is a niffen located in Hermit's Hovel in Zaralek Cavern.
Ysondre was once one of the four Dragons of Nightmare, and the only one that had been freed from the Nightmare's taint. Her freedom, however, was only a temporary affair.
Yuka Screwspigot is a goblin engineering vendor just past the entrance to Blackrock Depths. Before the Cataclysm, she was located at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

Young Wolves are wolf mobs that can be found in Elwynn Forest, just outside the gate to Northshire Valley. They often travel alongside a Mangy Wolf. These Young Wolf/Mangy Wolf pairs are linked; if one is attacked, the other will aggro as well, no matter the distance between them. Before the Cataclysm, they also dwelled in Northshire Valley proper. Eagan Peltskinner had put a bounty on the Young Wolves and Timber Wolves in Northshire, asking adventurers to fetch him their meat to cook. In the time leading up to the Cataclysm, these wolves contracted a mysterious disease, though they eventually recovered.

The final quest given to you by The Fallen Hero of the Horde. It involves killing Razelikh . Most players never reach this quest due to this quest series' length and difficulty. And have partially acknowledged by a Blizzard CM the fact that its rare to see somebody have this quest. (A Community Spotlight telling all the rare/hidden quests in WoW, "You are Rakh'likh, Demon", being one of them.)
Young Wetlands Crocolisk were crocolisks found in the Wetlands.
Young Threshadon are threshadons found deep within The Loch of Loch Modan.
Young Reef Crawlers are crabs found along the coast of Darkshore prior to the Cataclysm.
Young Murk Threshers are threshadons found in Dustwallow Marsh.
Young Mesa Buzzards are buzzards native to the Arathi Highlands.

__NOTOC__ Young Night Web Spiders are the young of the spiders that have overrun the gold mine at Night Web's Hollow. They are smaller and less aggressive than their parents, and lack the distinct black widow coloring. Executor Arren recruits newly risen Forsaken to help clear the mine.

Young Black Bears are bear cub mobs that can be found above Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh. They sit idly in Jermaine and Anton Buckey's camp, while their Black Bear guardians chase the two dwarves up a tree. Prior to Cataclysm, Young Black Bears roamed the area around Kharanos and along the road leading south from Kharanos. A small family of them also lived near the Ironforge Airfield.

Young Forest Bears are bear mobs that can be found throughout Elwynn Forest. They generally stick to the south, though some can be found north of the main road near Tower of Azora and Eastvale Logging Camp.
__NOTOC__ Battleboars are boars found in Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. Killing them and collecting their meat and snouts was required by Grull Hawkwind.

__NOTOC__ Young Thistle Boars live in the sheltering forest of Shadowglen on the great tree Teldrassil. Unfortunately, the thistle boar population in the area has recently skyrocketed to unhealthy numbers. The night elves of the area have begun culling the young boars in an attempt to keep their population in check.
Young Sawtooth Crocolisks are crocolisks found in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Young Scavengers are weak wolves found skulking around Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. They are occasionally hunted by the Forsaken of the town for their paws, which are somehow used to make armor. They are related to the larger Ragged Scavengers of the area.
Young Nightsabers are level 1 saber cats found in Teldrassil.
Young Panthers are panthers found in Northern Stranglethorn. One also appears in the Brawler's Guild encounter Stranglethorn Streak in Bizmo's Brawlpub and Brawl'gar Arena.
__NOTOC__ Young Stranglethorn Tigers are tigers found in Northern Stranglethorn.
Young Wavethrashers were hydras that live off the coast of northern Azshara.
You Survived! is the first quest for the draenei, in Ammen Vale

Ysiel Windsinger is a night elf quest giver located at Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh. She is located on the back porch of the inn. Ysiel is the leader of the Cenarion Expedition. She also appears in the Dreamgrove during the Burning Legion's third invasion.

You Are Rakh'Likh, Demon is a very long quest chain connected to the Blasted Lands. The initial quests for the Blasted Lands chain differs by faction, but the majority of the chain is neutral. This quest line gives a large amount of experience (which translates to gold as a level 60) The completion of the first 19 stages of the Horde side chain (Fall From Grace through Return to the Blasted Lands) nets you over 49 gold (assuming lvl 60 xp to gold conversion) as well as a mana/health regen trinket and a weapon used for completing the quest line (sells for additional 5g). The final portions cannot reasonably be soloed although decent soloing classes can solo the first 19 stages in 2–3 hours (t
The overseer did nothing to stop your imaginary revolt, so she too must die! This quest is part of the quest chain.
Your Friend On The Inside is Yarzill the Merc's introduction quest, available after completing Enter the Taskmaster at reputation with Netherwing.
This daily repeatable quest gives you a Crystalforged Darkrune. The Crystalforged Darkrune is used to start the Shartuul's Transporter event, notable for the loot acquired upon successful completion.
__NOTOC__ Ythyar is an ethereal found in Karazhan, right before the Chess Event.
You Have Served Us Well concludes the "A Noble Brew" quest chain. The final quest is only available to warlocks.
Young Sporebats can be found in Zangarmarsh. Killing them will result in +15 reputation with Sporeggar.

__NOTOC__ Yvette Farthing is a Forsaken located in the Gallows' End Tavern in the town of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Coleman Farthing is her brother. She loved Thurman Agamand, who wrote her a letter professing his undying love for her as the threat of the Scourge loomed ever closer. When presented with this letter, she despaired, but quickly hid her emotions, stating that she was Forsaken now, and such feelings were meaningless.

Young Wendigos are wendigo mobs that can be found at the Grizzled Den in Dun Morogh. They primarily wander outside the cave, as the inside is occupied by adult wendigo. They sometimes stop to eat from the boar corpses on the ground.
Young Crocolisk Skins drop from Young Wetlands Crocolisk in the Wetlands.

Yshmeel, a male murloc, is the chief nightcrawler of the Ripfang tribe. During large gatherings, he handles land-based security and scouting, and reports directly to his chieftain. Yshmeel is said to be the first murloc as comfortable on land as in water, or at least the first to be as quick, quiet and deadly in both environments.
__NOTOC__ Yrma is a draenei vendor who creates alternate top-end armor from dropped top-end armor and a Sunmote. She is located at Sun's Reach Harbor on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Yuriv's Tombstone can be found in The Sepulcher of Silverpine Forest.
Young Lashtail Raptors are raptors found in Stranglethorn Vale.
Young Stranglethorn Raptors are raptors found in Stranglethorn Vale.
Young Black Ravagers are wolves found just beyond the Hushed Bank in Duskwood.
Young Jungle Stalkers are raptors found in Stranglethorn Vale, often with mature Jungle Stalkers.
You'll Need a Bear is part of The Sons of Hodir quest chain.
You Can't Miss Him is a quest which is part of the Sons of Hodir quest chain.
You Don't Have an Eternity (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Malygos in 6 minutes or less in the Eye of Eternity on 25-player mode.
This quest may be acquired without having completed the others in the chain.

The Young Furbolg Shaman is one of several young Stillpine shaman who stumbled across Bristlelimb Enclave and were slaughtered. Jol wants to resurrect one Young Furbolg Shaman in Redemption (2) with the help of a Symbol of Life.
__NOTOC__ The Young Twilight Drake Skull is recovered from Young Twilight Drakes found at Ascendant's Rise in Mount Hyjal.
Ysida's Locket is provided as an objective for Proof of Life.
Yuldris Smolderfury is a draenei shaman of the Earthen Ring located in the Temple of Earth in Deepholm and later in the Twilight Highlands.
You'll Feel Right as Rain is a Cooking achievement earned for feeling 1000 times better by eating Chocolate Cookies.
Ystelle Oaksong is a night elf patrolling The Regrowth in Mount Hyjal with four Hyjal Wardens during the Firelands Invasion.
__NOTOC__ Yoth'al the Devourer is a faceless one in Darkshore.
Young Snow Leopards are snow leopard mobs found near New Tinkertown in Dun Morogh. They mainly wander the strip of land between the Toxic Airfield and Iceflow Lake.

Yu'lon the Jade Serpent is one of the four creatures known as the August Celestials who watch over Pandaria. Yu'lon watches over the Jade Forest. She is the spirit of wisdom, but also represents spring, youth, growth, and nurturing. She occasionally disguises herself as a pandaren girl named Fei.
You Don't Have an Eternity - Guild Edition is criteria for the meta achievement Glory of the Lich King Raider.
The Young Ironjaw can be fished in Ironforge for One fer the Ages. It's then exhibited in the Ironforge museum.
__NOTOC__ Young Dustback Mushan are mushan located in Dustback Gorge in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Young Frostsabers are saber cats found in Winterspring. If they reach low health, they will cry out for help from the adults.

Yun is a pandaren located at Zhu's Watch in Krasarang Wilds. He fell under the sha's influence and became depressed like the rest. It wasn't until an adventurer came along that freed the village of its sha problem, after which he can be seen building a boat.

Yu'lon Disciples are pandaren located at the Jade Temple Grounds and the establishment at Windspire Bridge in the Jade Forest. They're found dead in the Temple of the Jade Serpent while also having a sha aura on them. When the Burning Legion invaded the Temple, several of them were seen holding a door.

Yu'lon Priests are pandaren located in the Temple of the Jade Serpent, Jade Temple Grounds, the establishment in the Windspire Bridge, and patroling the Windspire in the Jade Forest. In the instance version, they're found dead with the sha aura on them.

Yu'lon Scribes are pandaren who write the scrolls from the un-instanced Scrollkeeper's Sanctum in the Temple of the Jade Serpent. When the Burning Legion invaded the temple, they were being strangulated by the demons. Master Windstrong asked the Grandmaster of the Order of the Broken Temple to rescue them.
Yu'lon Guardians are pandaren located at the Jade Temple Grounds in the Jade Forest, they are seen patrolling or standing to eliminate potential sha.
__NOTOC__ Yu'lon Adepts are pandaren found at the Jade Temple Grounds in the Jade Forest. They're seen kneeling, fighting Training Targets and also sha infestations.
Young Dawn Watchers are pandaren children found in the Dawn's Blossom of the Jade Forest.
The Young Cloud Serpent is a cloud serpent found in the Arboretum in the Jade Forest. It is following a Serpent Trainer.
Young Grizzled Thistle Bears are brown bears found in Darkshore. They can be found in a small area in southern Darkshore between the Grove of the Ancients and Blackwood Den.
You Are Not Your $#*@! Legplates (Season 1) is a Legacy achievement that was obtained for killing Bruce during the first Brawler's Guild season.
Young Students are three unnamed pandaren children found at the Dawning Span. They are listening to Lorewalker Amai's history lesson. Nan, Hao, and Yin are named.
__NOTOC__ Young Primal Devilsaurs are devilsaurs found on the Isle of Giants.

You Made Me Bleed My Own Blood is a quest achievement earned for killing Fleshcrafter Hoku without killing any of the Posessed Blood that he spawns as part of the encounter. See Hoku's article for more information. This achievement is required for the meta-achievement, Stormbreaker.
You Said Crossing the Streams Was Bad is an achievement that is awarded for revealing the Orange, Purple, and Green Fog Beasts during the Durumu the Forgotten fight in the Throne of Thunder.

__NOTOC__ Yun Applebarrel is a pandaren vendor found on the outskirts of Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds. He stands along the side of the eastern road with a wagon of giant apples, calling out to passerby.
You Mean That Wasn't a Void Zone? is an achievement earned for defeating Rak'gor Bloodrazor without any member of your party standing in a Healing Ward during the encounter in the Dagger in the Dark.

You're Doing it Wrong (Level 90) is an achievement awarded for successfully completing any Basic Silver trial in the Proving Grounds scenario, while in a specialization not suited for the chosen challenge.
Yumi Goldenpaw is a level 90 pandaren located at Setting Sun Garrison of Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
To contribute to this achievement, you must have 3 guild members in the same group to be considered a 'guild group' for scenarios.
Yukiko is a rare wind serpent found to the north of the Stagalbog Cave in the Swamp of Sorrows.
You'll Get Caught Up In The... Frostfire! is a quest achievement earned for completing the Frostfire Ridge storylines.

Your Cloud Serpent is a cloud serpent located at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
__NOTOC__ Your Hatchling is a cloud serpent located at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest. He grows into Your Cloud Serpent.
Yu Sugargale is a pandaren located at the Shrine of Dreaming Stones in the Wandering Isle.
Yu Ming the Blade was a pandaren who long ago trained at Tian Monastery.
__NOTOC__ The Young Talbuk has a chance to drop from Traveler's Pet Supplies.
Yu'rina the Mystic is a jungle troll located in the Frostwall's Garrison.
Yrel's Watch is a camp of the Alliance in , located in the central part of the region.
__NOTOC__ Yukla Greenshadow is a blood elf enchanter located in the Frostwall's Enchanter's Study. For enchanters, she will sell new formulas. For non-enchanters, she will make items instead.
__NOTOC__ Yowlon's Mark is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.
Young Deep Water Clackers are crabs found in the Great Sea off the shores of Val'sharah and the Broken Shore. They usually travel in packs of up to nine.
Yuri Lowenthal is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions. His spouse is Tara Platt.
You Gotta Keep 'em Separated is an achievement earned from killing Xhul'horac in on Normal difficulty or higher without triggering any Shadowfel Annihilations.
__NOTOC__ Yvelyn is a green dragon found in Malorne's Nightmare.
You're Gonna Need A Bigger Boat! is a stand-alone quest available from Dread Captain DeMeza at Booty Bay during Pirates' Day.
Yrgrim the Truthseeker is an iron vrykul located at the Tomb of the Old Kings in Stormheim. He guards the paladin artifact Truthguard.

You Used to Scrawl Me In Your Fel Tome is an achievement earned by finding and reading all of entries of Illysanna Ravencrest's diary scattered throughout Black Rook Hold. There are a total of six notes hidden throughout the dungeon and it can be completed on any difficulty.

You're Just Making It WORSE! is an achievement earned by defeating Millificent Manastorm in Assault on Violet Hold on Mythic difficulty after using Manastorm's Duplicator, activating Millificent's Rage.

Yowlon is a massive dark grey-brown owlcat who can be found near the bridge in western Suramar. He is the alpha male of a large pack of feathermane owlcats... but several of his kittens have fallen prey to a hungry ettin. He is having trouble herding his remaining kittens.
Ysera's Dream is a carrier located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
Yu'lei, Daughter of Jade is sold by Mistweaver Xia on the Timeless Isle for . __NOTOC__
You're Really Doing It Wrong is an achievement awarded for successfully completing any Basic Gold trial in the Proving Grounds scenario, while in a specialization not suited for the chosen challenge.
Young Duskcloaks are panthara located in the Petrified Forest in Krokuun.
Yushi is a pandaren located on the Wandering Isle. He requisitions a Seal of Broken Fate at the order hall of the monks.
You Are Sixteen was an achievement earned by reaching Honor Prestige Level 16.
You Are Not The Contents Of Your Wallet is an achievement earned from obtaining 20,000 Brawler's Gold.
Ysera's Dream Draught is obtained by mixing one Dreamer's Tear Leaves and 5 Dreamleaf with a Nightborne Flask.
You Are Now Prepared! is a quest achievement earned for completing the Argus storyline.
Yseralline Poultice can be found next to the injured sentries in Lorlathil in Val'sharah during invasions.
__NOTOC__ The Young Venomfang can drop from Damp Pet Supplies.
Ysildar was a gargantuan ice-blue serpent who was defeated by the vrykul in ancient times, according to the biased vrykul legend "The Wanderer and the Serpent".
Yrvar Isilmar is a vrykul who recorded a chapter in The Legend of Odyn.
Young Venomhide Ravasaur is a ravasaur located in Un'Goro Crater.
Young Stalkers are tigers located in the Jade Forest. They accompany Rakira.
Yoska Rainsinger is a tauren located at Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley.
Young Pterrorwings are skyscreamers located on the Isle of Thunder. They are summoned by Zandalari Beast Handlers.
Young Skyscreamers are skyscreamers located on the Isle of Thunder.
__NOTOC__ Yvera Dawnwing is a high elf located at both Boralus Harbor in Boralus and Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. She offers portals between the two locations to soldiers of the Alliance.
Yotnar's Pride is a quest reward from The Blessing of the Watchers.
Yotnar's Turmoil is a quest reward from The Blessing of the Watchers.
Young Mutant Warturtles can be purchased from Laura Malley in the Underbelly of Dalaran for .
Yuyan is a pandaren located at the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.
The Young Drake's Impulse is a quest reward from Saving Stellagosa.
__NOTOC__ Yuke is a pandaren located on the expedition isles.
The Young Twilight Scale is automatically deposited into the player's bag upon their first capture of a Twilight Whelpling.
You Are Here - X is a map found in Deathmist Hills in Tiragarde Sound.
__NOTOC__ Young Xibalan Apexes are devilsaurs located in Zuldazar.
Yuwija is a jungle troll innkeeper located in Mudfisher Cove in Drustvar.
Ysedra the Darkener is a human located atop the Maker's Rise in the Halls of Origination.

Yox'ith is a massive eye stalk located at the Engine of Nalak'sha in the Mogu'shan Vaults. Yox'ith has four Tentacles that can be brought down as well. Each tentacle killed will deal 10% of Yox'ith's max health to it.
Young Savagelands Devilsaurs are devilsaurs located in Zuldazar.
You and What Army? is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by defeating Abyssal Commander Sivara in The Eternal Palace while all three of her lieutenants are alive and engaged in the fight.
Young Etherwyrms are etherwyrms located at the Small Shrine in Bastion.

Yoshai the Merciless is a soul located in Revendreth who is part of The Penintent Hunt quest. They await with Houndmaster Loksey, Traitor Athu'ne, Tyrant Dalgrog, Crimelord Tiana, Krossa the Cruel and The Accuser.
The Young Seaweed Stalk is found amongst electric seaweed in the fatigue waters of Venture Bay in the Grizzly Hills.

Yu Yi is a pandaren child training to be a shaman under the Earthen Ring. When Zekhan arrived at the Western Earthshrine, the child and her friends took advantage of the situation to ask him about the assassination attempt on Talanji only for Lorlidrel to arrive soon after, who informed Zekhan that the Horde Council wished to see him.
Young Beaky is an untamable level 11 parrot battle pet owned by Bill Buckler found at the Wild Shore in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Yotnar's Head is thrown by God-King Skovald in Aggramar's Vault in Stormheim.
The Young Wildseed is a wildseed located in a hollow under Tirna Vaal in Ardenweald.
Your Covenant's Flavor is an expansion feature achievement earned by unlocking Rank V of your Sanctum's Special Feature.
__NOTOC__ The Young Matriarch is a gorm located in the Underweald of Ardenweald.
Yrgrim's Journey is a tablet located in Shield's Rest in Stormheim.
Yrgrim's Challenge is a tablet located in Shield's Rest in Stormheim.
Yrgrim's Rest is a tablet located in Shield's Rest in Stormheim.
__NOTOC__ Young Bluehide Mushan are mushan located in the Dread Wastes.
Your Next Move were three quests planned to be breadcrumbs for other zones on Zandalar, taken from the Scouting Map.
Young Twilight Drakes are twilight drakes located at Ascendant's Rise in Mount Hyjal.
Ysondre's Tear is provided for Sealing the Dream in Feralas. It's used to close the Emerald Dream portal at Dream Bough, cutting off the Emerald Nightmare's corrupting influence on the area.
Yotnar's Left Foot is found at Aggramar's Vault in Stormheim.
Yotnar's Left Arm is found at Aggramar's Vault in Stormheim.
Yotnar's Right Arm is found at Aggramar's Vault in Stormheim.
Yotnar's Right Foot is found at Aggramar's Vault in Stormheim.
Young Pilgrims are child blood elves located in the Sunwell Plateau during the quest The Purification of Quel'Delar.
Young Boars are boars located in Razorfen Kraul. After approaching them, they run away.
__NOTOC__ Yumadormu is a bronze dragon located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
You Must Be Made of Hide is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Umbrelskul without being hit by a polymorph trap or triggering a Shriek within The Azure Vault on Mythic difficulty.
Yusa's Hearty Stew is a player-contributed feast created with Dragon Isles Cooking (30); taught by Recipe: Yusa's Hearty Stew.
__NOTOC__ Yries Lightfingers is a Lightforged draenei located at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores.
__NOTOC__ Yuyu is a small dog sitting next to the Zen'shiri Trading Post in Orgrimmar next to their owner Aetheil.
Young Salamanthers are salamanthers located at Hornswog Hollow in the Waking Shores.
Young Tideskippers are dolphins located off the northern shores of the Waking Shores.
__NOTOC__ Ysemerald is a raw gem from Prospecting used in several Dragon Isles jewelcrafting designs.
__NOTOC__ Young Quickhands is a tuskarr fishing trainer located in Grimtusk's Hideaway in Azure Span.
Young Mosshairs are mammoth calves located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
You Know How to Reach Me is an exploration achievement earned by completing all of the Forbidden Reach achievements.
You Had it Coming is a profession achievement earned by getting what you deserve.
You Saw Nothing is a profession achievement earned by crafting a Gordok Ogre Suit with the Leatherworking profession and use it while engaged in combat with Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
Young Wind Serpents are wind serpents located in the Waking Shores.

Your Inner Turmoil is summoned during The Cleansing, at the Frostblade Shrine atop Frostblade Peak in Howling Fjord. It is an exact mirror image of your character, with the same armor and weapons, and you must defeat it in order to earn credit for the quest and continue along the chain. Defeating your Inner Turmoil "lightens your soul", allowing you to slow-fall from the top of the peak.

__NOTOC__ Zaeldarr the Outcast is an undead dire troll that leads a band of undead trolls in Undercroft in the Eastern Plaguelands. They are known to steal corpses from the pit near Light's Hope Chapel. Caretaker Alen and Urk Gagbaz want Zaeldarr's head.

ZOMG is an acronym used in the same context as "OMG!", except the Z does not stand for anything. It was originally a typo, as when people type "OMG" they press the left shift key down and inadvertently hit the Z key as well. It is now often intentionally misspelled not unlike pwn.

Zamja is a jungle troll cooking trainer located in Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, she was located in the Drag. After Vol'jin's death, she was seen speaking with Xen'to and Xon'cha. She appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
Zandalar Demonia Robes were cloth chest armor with heavy stamina usable only by Warlocks. It also increased damage and healing done by spells, and increases spell hit chance.
Zandalar Illusionist Robes was cloth chest armor useable only by Mages with intellect and stamina. It also increased damage and healing done by spells, and increased spell hit chance.

The Zandalar Tribe sets are a collection of 5-piece sets acquired from the old Zul'Gurub 20-man raid via quests requiring token drops from the raid, as well as reputation with the Zandalar Tribe. The sets were removed from the game with the new 5-man version of Zul'Gurub replacing the raid in Patch 4.1.0
The Zandalar Haruspex's Belt is a leather belt for Druids that gives a bonus to stamina, intellect, and spirit. It is part of the Haruspex's Garb set.
The Zandalar Haruspex's Tunic is a leather chestpiece for Druids that gives a bonus to stamina, intellect, and spirit. It is part of the Haruspex's Garb set.

Zan Shivsproket is a gnome engineering vendor found in the basement of Ravenholdt Manor in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Zan is an engineering vendor, and his most important item for sale is the limited supply Schematic: Gnomish Cloaking Device. He also appears in the Hall of Shadows.
The Zandalar Demoniac's Mantle is a cloth shoulderguard for warlocks. The mantle is part of the armor set called the Demoniac's Threads.
Zandalar Demoniac's Wraps are cloth bracers for warlocks. The wraps is part of the armor set called Demoniac's Threads.
Zalashji's Den was the home of Zalashji the naga, located in eastern Tanaris, until the cataclysm flooded the area and collapsed the small cave. It's unknown if Zalashji survived.
Zandalar Signet of Mojo is a signet that can be used to enchant any shoulder item with a caster bonus to damage & healing.
The Zandalar Signet of Might is the melee version of the Zul'Gurub shoulder enchantment.
Zandalar Signet of Serenity was the healer version of the Zul'Gurub shoulder enchantment.

Zalas Witherbark is a rare forest troll found in the cave south of Witherbark Village in the Arathi Highlands. He is on a 48 to 72 hour respawn timer.

Zalazane's Fall (also referred to as the Battle to reclaim the Echo Isles) was the final push by Vol'jin and the Darkspear tribe to retake the Echo Isles from the clutches of the evil Zalazane. It was a culminating event for the Horde to occur before the release of the next expansion, Cataclysm. Furthermore, all troll characters created after the liberation of the Echo Isles now have their new starting point there. The event started on the 7th of September, 2010 (USA) and the next day on EU servers.

Za's Head drops from Za'brox in the Den of the Disciples in the Twilight Highlands.

Z50 Mana Gulper is an tinker enchant (only usable by players with Engineering) to gloves. It can be used to increase the mana gained from using a Mythical Mana Potion. As such, this is by no means a "free" mana potion - it will only work if there's a Mythical Mana Potion in the player's inventory to consume.
Zandalari Nomads are Zandalari trolls located in the Valley of Emperors and the Tomb of Shadows in Kun-Lai Summit.

Zach Chow is a pandaren found in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle. He has a tiger companion named Azunyan.

Za'Tual is a Zandalari troll territory on the southwestern side of the Isle of Thunder. Bordered by the Court of Bones to the north, the Diremoor to the northeast, and the Ihgaluk Crag to the east. The Staff of the Chamberlain can be found at one of several locations in Za'Tual for The Crumbled Chamberlain.

Zandalari Library Card is a quest achievement earned for looting five rare books off the corpses of Zandalari trolls on the Isle of Thunder. Said trolls can be found in Za'Tual, the Beast Pens, and Conqueror's Terrace. This achievement is required for the meta-achievement, Stormbreaker.
The Zanchuli Council advises the rulers of the Zandalari Empire, and ensures their every command is executed upon.
